Fix extremely large structures causing stack overflows (#101)

In Firefox, functions can have at most 500000 parameters; and in Chromium, function parameters are put on a stack, which has a limit of around ~120000. This meant that the spawn animation logic, which removes the initial delay by finding when the first ghost block starts animating, crashed pack generation when there were lots of blocks (I'm talking 814149). This has been fixed with an imperative min function that works limitlessly for arrays.
Also fix the "~ blocks upgraded" info log from not showing up in Chromium browsers.

Finish support for all blocks, add structure updating (#79)

- Using
[pmmp/BedrockBlockUpgradeSchema](https://github.com/pmmp/BedrockBlockUpgradeSchema),
blocks from older Minecraft versions are now automatically updated to
the latest version. This does not do everything perfectly, but it does a
pretty good job at updating everything! I've tested it with some of Mad
Hatter's old test structures from Structura and it seems to handle the
updating pretty well.
- Shulker boxes now show the correct textures and are rotated correctly.
They use the shulker (entity) textures so it's two cubes not one.
- Add jigsaw block rotations

- Add models for beds, heads and skulls
- I wanted to read models/mobs.json to get the geometry, to make it
resource pack compatible, but this will do for 99% of players.
- Beds use a new field in `materialListMappings.json` which adds the
value of a block entity property onto the item aux id for material
lists.
- Heads/Skulls use a new box UV format for cubes, which is found in many
entity models and will be used later when adding entities to holograms.
- Hide "fruit" on jungle leaves
- Fix double slabs
- Update wiki links
- Update to 1.21.60
- Since blocks from older versions are automatically updated to the
latest version (1.21.60), rotations for doors and fence gates had to be
changed.
- Fix unknown variant errors for mycelium, prismarine stairs, and (red)
sandstone stairs
- Bones that have their rotation set to [0, 0, 0] through block state
definitions will now no longer include this redundant property
- Fixed bug with duplicate locators for validation particles in
multi-structure packs
- Allow rotations and texture variants to be defined by block entity
data as well (even though they're in blockStateDefinitions.json...)
- Fix https://github.com/SuperLlama88888/holoprint/issues/77: Resource
packs including files that HoloPrint modifies (namely
armor_stand.entity.json) caused pack generation to fail. This was
because the Response objects created after merging the vanilla file and
the file from the resource pack lost the url property, which was being
used to determine the file path. This caused armor_stand.entity.json to
be read as a Blob. Now, it looks at the file path of the requested
resource rather than the Response url.
- Fix vanilla resource pack stack being duplicated
- Remove gifs from bundles
- Make block translation coverage check run before sample structures

Make block validation be done by layer, add support for some technical RPs (#38)

layer. This is the case even in "all layers below" layer mode. There is

could've looked at the auto-generated screenshots from the PR to check

with that, I couldn't make it work. (Also, reading blockshape from RPs
isn't supported yet.)

Make layer mode toggleable in-game, many minor improvements (#36)

the default view, there is no state for that and it skips straight to

- Rename "hologram scale" to "ghost block scale"
- Optimise image fetching:
- TextureAtlas.js now avoids fetching the same image URL multiple times
if it appears in multiple image fragments. This significantly reduces
the number of fetch() requests made.
- Make CachingFetchers have 3 fetch() attempts, in case they fail due to
Chromium giving up. This issue was observed when fetching 1600+ images
before the aforementioned optimisation in TextureAtlas.js, and will
probably never happen again due to there only being ~1100 individual
block textures.
- Make the "decrease layer" (logs) in-game control work with the player
as well, not just the armour stand (even though players can crouch with
the regular "change layer" control for the same effect).

Add pack name setting, fix structure file extraction for completed packs (#21)

- The final pack name can now be set in the Metadata tab.
- The in-game pack name will now no longer have "HoloPrint: " at the
start, and if the default pack name is > 40 characters it will be
shortened.

structure files is now supported.
- Original file names for structure files are put in their comments, a
really niche feature for only zip files apparently.

Add multi-structure support (#20)

- Packs can now have multiple structures in them, which can be changed by hitting the armour stand when it's holding nothing (thanks Indyficcient!), or attacking with an arrow. Changing structures will stop validating and reset the layer mode to show everything.
- A combined file hash is calculated by concatening the files, which is uploaded along with each individual file hash.
- UI has yet to be updated for this, and combines all file currently into the same pack. I want to add an option to split up different files into different packs for batching.
- Bounding box and block validation particles work by having a different animation controller state and different particles for each structure.
- Valid structure overlay dimensions have been updated to use Molang.
- Alignment and offset wrappers have been combined into the same name, which reduces the need for duplicate animations
- Moved all JSDoc types to the bottom of HoloPrint.js, from which other files import them.
- SQL has been updated both here and in the database to work with multiple file hashes and stuff; let's hope it doesn't break!
- Add instruction images for changing structures and disabling player controls
- Fix lectern and enchanting table book cover textures being flipped
- Make launch files (i.e. opened with PWA) behave the same as drag-and-dropping them
- Make touch material list button appear above chat, and disappear when the HUD is hidden

Add armour stand controls, fix bugs (#8)

- Fix #1: Moved most temp variables to local variables on armour stands.
Armour stands now have their own settings which can be changed by giving

the same action.
- Player controls now work in a slightly different way; since they don't
control the global settings anymore, they simply broadcast instructions
to armour stands.
- Block validation particles work as best as they can now. They no
longer throw errors if temp is cleared, but they're still a bit wonky.
They work fine if temp isn't cleared.
- Remove individual bounding box particle files, in favour of
pre_effect_script instead of
minecraft:emitter_initialization.creation_expression
- Compress preview renderer cubemap images (~20%)
- Fix stone brick stairs giving a warning, glass pane bottom texture,
chiseled bookshelf rotations, and a bit of glitchy rendering on cactus
- Fix multiple rotations (>2) being applied in the wrong order. This
doesn't change anything now, but means it will be correct if we use this
more in the future.
- Add end gateways
- Remove ramblings from README.md (they've been moved to the
repository's wiki on GitHub)
- Fix #6
- Update function -> Molang converter to expand `else if(...) {...}`
into `else { if(...) {...} }` (it's very messy)
- Fix PWA icon paths (hopefully)

Add cauldrons, fix top/bottom face orientation

- Fix z-fighting on bottom of composters
- In Minecraft, top/bottom textures display the opposite way to how they look in geometries. This was apparent in the top of cauldrons (and probably composters). By setting negative UV sizes, we can get the desired rotation effect. The auto UV offsets for top-bottom faces also had to be updated. Fix incorrect copied cube behaviour

- Fix rotated bone cubes not being scaled correctly.

Add resource caching

Each resource pack stack has its own unique cache, which it uses to store HTTP responses. This cache is stored in-browser and means resource fetching is much faster on subsequent pack creations.

Add bubble columns, pointed dripstone, fix stuff

- Bubble column is modelled after the non-fancy model, since I'm too lazy to implement particles.
- Pointed dripstone is a bit hacky; instead of the different thicknesses being in terrain_texture.json variants, they're in different faces in blocks.json. Instead of changing which face we're looking at, I've hardcoded in the terrain texture keys.
- Added transparency to water and slime (which is already transparent but not enough)
- Fixed door textures
- Fixed honey block texture

Fix half-pixel textures messing everything up, update to 1.21.41

- If an image fragment requires a fraction of a pixel, instead of trying to grab that bit (which messes up itself and other textures), it now grabs all of that pixel and uses that in the texture atlas. The geometry uv and uv_size can then safely reference part of that pixel.
- The only issue from this is that the outline is still applied around the border of the pixel, which is not included since we're only looking at a part of that pixel, leading to some edges missing outlines. Fixing this would be annoying and a waste of time.
- Updated vanilla resources to 1.21.40/1.21.41, and removed newly futile blocks.json patches!
- Added sample structure for pressure plates.

Add item frames (without items) and pack updating
